name.ja: BB戦士 三国伝 機駕太傅 司馬懿サザビー
name.en: BB Senshi Three Kingdoms Legend of Machinery Sima Yi Sazabi

ja: 機駕を束ねる機駕太傅“司馬懿サザビー”が新章登場時の姿でキット化 サザビー本来の機体色である赤をカラーメッキ仕様で再現 武将モード、軍師モードの2形態へ組み換え可能 武器の“銀の牙”と“紅翼扇”は“牙翼の大剣”へ合体
en: Sima Yi Sazabi, the aircraft commander who binds the aircraft, is made into a kit as it appears in the new chapter. Sazabi's original red aircraft color is reproduced with color plating. Can be rearranged into two forms: military commander mode and tactician mode. The weapons "Silver Fang " and " Red Wing Fan " are combined into the " Fang Wing Great Sword".
